sentences.text:
This A.B.A. is assigned by Hon'ble the Acting Chief Justice
 to this Bench.
2. Heard learned counsel appearing for the petitioner and learned A.P.P. for the State.

3. The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Katkamsandi P.S. Case No. 312 of 2023, registered for the alleged offence under Sections 406, 420, 341, 323, 325, 307, 354, 379, 504,
506/34 of the Indian Penal Code, pending in the Court of the learned Judicial Magistrate, 1st Class,
Hazaribag.
4.

entities.text:
Court of the learned Judicial Magistrate, 1st Class,
Hazaribag
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the alleged occurrence is said to be occurred on 24.06.2023 whereas the F.I.R. was lodged on 05.07.2023 i.e. after lapse of 12 days and there is no explanation of delay in lodging the F.I.R.

By way of drawing the attention of the court towards the order the learned Sessions Judge, he submits that in spite of calling of the injury report by the learned Sessions Judge, no injury report was produced by the prosecution in spite of the repeated directions.
He further submits that the other co- accused has already been provided the privilege of anticipatory bail in A.B.A. No. 1470 of 2024 by this court.
5. Learned A.P.P. for the State has opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail on the ground that the allegation of assault is there.

6. It transpires that the alleged occurrence is said to be occurred on 24.06.2023 whereas the F.I.R.
was lodged on 05.07.2023 i.e. after lapse of 12 days and there is no explanation of delay in lodging Israfil Ansari @ Md. Israfil vs The State Of Jharkhand ..... ... ... on 14 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/16228773/

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: the F.I.R and further one of the co-accused has already been provided the privilege of anticipatory bail in A.B.A. No. 1470 of 2024 by this court and the order of the learned Sessions Judge suggests that in spite of repeated directions, the injury report was not produced before the learned court by the prosecution.
7. In view of the attending facts and circumstances of the case, I am inclined to grant anticipatory bail to the petitioner.

Accordingly, he is directed to surrender before the learned court within three weeks from today and in the event of his surrender / arrest, the petitioner, named above, shall be released on bail, on furnishing bail bonds of Rs. 25,000/- (twenty-five thousand), with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of learned Judicial Magistrate, 1st Class, Hazaribag, in connection with Katkamsandi P.S. Case No. 312 of 2023, subject to conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.

(Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi, J.) Amitesh/-
